MARIGOLD-9083

The records are structured as a repeating sequence of ten distinct phrases, each consisting of four specific words, which cycle continuously from Record 0 through Record 1027. Each record contains the phrase repeated four times, followed by a trailing number that increments sequentially from 0 to 96 before resetting to 0 and repeating. Two specific notes interrupt this pattern at Record 101 and Record 871 to provide the access codes for vaults ALPHA and OMEGA, respectively.
